upstream_non_osm_source.title: A first high-quality vector data of buildings in East Asian countries based on a comprehensive large-scale mapping framework
upstream_non_osm_source.coverage_statement: China, Japan, North Korea, South Korea and Mongolia
upstream_non_osm_source.citation: Qian Shi, Jiajun Zhu, Zhengyu Liu, Haonan Guo, Mengxi Liu, Zihong Liu and Xiaoping Liu (2023), A first high-quality vector data of buildings in East Asian countries based on a comprehensive large-scale mapping framework, Zenodo, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8174931

retained_non_osm_increment.selection_rule: SITE-001-intersecting Overture buildings whose source dataset set is exactly doi:10.5281/zenodo.8174931; OSM-sourced Overture features are excluded to avoid duplicating the existing OSM layer.

method: Downloaded the release-specific building theme through the official bbox client, validated the release state and all source geometries, clipped by provisional SITE-001, projected areas to EPSG:4548, matched Overture OSM record IDs against the retained OSM snapshot, excluded all OSM-sourced Overture features, and appended only the East Asian non-OSM increment to the canonical existing-condition building layer.
usage_boundary: Open concept-stage building-footprint/roofprint screening only. Overture release date is not an acquisition or survey date; the retained upstream source was published in 2023 and carries a 2024-11-01 Overture source update timestamp, while source imagery dates and per-feature confidence are not established here. Automated footprints can contain omission, commission, roof displacement, generalisation and multipart errors. The provisional clip, sparse height/floor attributes and nonstatutory licensing prevent use for cadastral, ownership, permit, demolition, precise building area/height, fire, accessibility, structural, utility, as-built or survey-acceptance conclusions.
